body:
Owner-reported (tvofi). The owner's report, as the orchestrator's plan recorded it:

> ### Fix-phase scope added by tvofi (2026-10-14): the replay lane
> - `tests/replay.py` and `tools/replay/export.py` are already on main. The only fixture is `tests/replay/synthetic-dhw-only.json`, and no real recorded day exists.
> - One roster group lands the lane fully:
>   - a real day from tvofi's install, through `export.py`'s allowlist into `tests/replay/<day>.json`;
>   - the fix for #2205, where CPU doubles on synthetic-dhw-only, which also unblocks #2202;
>   - the lane gated nightly as 0012 move 2 states.
> - D14-s3 (nightly-replay) re-runs on the real day once it has landed.

**Evidence.** Owner scope 2026-10-14. #2205 is closed (RCA dev/audit/rca/R10-RCA-2205.md, re-centre #2217).

**Roster group.** `R10-REPLAY-LANE` in `dev/programme/rosters/wave-r10-groups.json` (lane RP, wave 12, size M, after: R10-DIAG-REPLAY). The group's brief carries the fix shape, the null control and the forward-carried constraints.

**Closing.** The group's pull request names this issue with a closing keyword in prose; the orchestrator verifies it closed after the merge.
title: [R10-REPLAY-LANE] Land the replay lane: a real recorded day as a fixture, gated nightly
